Bank of America Invests in Jio Financial

Bank of America is investing $1.9 billion for a 49.9% stake in Jio Financial's NBFC unit. The deal is worth ₹18,268 crore. This investment is part of Bank of America's larger commitments, which include deploying $250 billion to bolster AI and energy infrastructure. The specific focus of this $250 billion deployment is on US projects, aiming to support the 'America First' agenda. The investment in Jio Financial marks a significant move into India's financial sector. Bank of America's commitment to various sectors underscores its strategic investment approach.
